main_text.p: Ac אֶתְהֶם ethbhem [?] e: אֹתָם otham, ipsos.
main_text.head: Singularis Numerus.
main_text.p: N. הִיא hi, hæc, ea, ipsa.
G. שֶׁלָּה schellah, ipsius. Affixū ה ha, vel ה cum Mappik, cum nominibus Ejus: cum verbis Eam.
main_text.head: Pluralis Numerus.
main_text.p: N. הֵנָּה henna & הֵן hen, ipsæ.
G. שֶׁלָּהֵן schellahen, ipsarum. Affixū ] Nun cum nominibus Earum: cum verbis Eas: Et הֵן hen cum solis nominibus, pluralibus Earum.
Ac. אֹתָן othan & אֶתְהֵן ethhen, ipsas.
Ab. מֵהֵן mehen, ab ipsis. Affixa tertiæ

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are copied as far as they could be read at this scan resolution; the points under the Hebrew in the first line (ethbhem) are uncertain. The "&" beside הנה and הן and the bracket after "Affixū" in the plural G. line are printed as shown. The Hebrew points under "Ab." and "Ac." lines may differ slightly from the printer's exact marks.
